text: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Nahar Retail Trading Services Limited ( Nahar ), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has entered into a binding term sheet dated 22nd October 2026 with TreBits Investment Trust, a Small and Medium Real Estate Investment Trust registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (the  Trust ), in relation to the proposed divestment of its entire shareholding (100%) in its wholly owned subsidiary, Netria Property Holdings Limited.
Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter for transfer of equity shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund ( IEPF )
